caption: The drawing depicts a monochromatic, pencil-shaded image of a horse viewed from the side, positioned within the center of the composition. The horse is shown in a running pose with its front right and rear left legs outstretched forward, and its front left and rear right legs bent beneath its body. The mane is combed to one side and the tail is extended outward horizontally behind the horse. The horse is mounted on a straight horizontal base, and there is a vertical post aligned with the horse's front left leg, extending from the base upward. Below the depiction of the horse, there is a small scale labeled "0 1 2 3 4'" and the name "Gordon Sanborn" is written in the lower left corner of the page. The lines of the drawing are clear and precise, and the shading is consistent, giving a sense of dimensionality to the horse's form. The background is plain and unshaded. The entire scene is framed by a thin, rectangular border.
title: Horse Weather Vane
